title: The world's biggest megacities
examples: Which is the biggest city in the world?

items.label: Dhaka
items.ask: Which is the biggest city in the world?

explain.say: A megacity is a city with more than 10 million people, as many as whole countries like Portugal or Sweden. Look at the board. These are some of the biggest megacities on Earth, by one United Nations count from 2025.

items.label: Dhaka
items.ask: Which is the biggest city in the world?

explain.say: Look at the biggest bar: Jakarta in Indonesia, with about 42 million people in its whole urban area. That means the city plus the towns that have grown into it. Jakarta is so crowded, and sinking so fast, that Indonesia is building a new capital called Nusantara. Can you believe a city can sink?

items.label: Dhaka
items.ask: Which is the biggest city in the world?

explain.say: Next comes Dhaka in Bangladesh, about 37 million, growing so fast it may become the biggest of all. Then Tokyo, about 33 million, which topped the list for decades. Tokyo is now shrinking slowly, because few babies are born in Japan. Can you spot Tokyo’s bar?

items.label: Dhaka
items.ask: Which is the biggest city in the world?

explain.say: See Cairo, beside the Nile, at about 26 million, the biggest on this list in Africa. Lagos in Nigeria is growing fast too. Rankings change depending on where you draw a city’s edge, so different lists can give different winners. Why do you think the edge matters?

items.label: Dhaka
items.ask: Which is the biggest city in the world?

explain.say: By the 2025 UN count there were 33 megacities, and 19 of them were in Asia, including Delhi and Shanghai. Great work! Challenge: find the biggest city in your country. How many people live there?

items.label: Dhaka
items.ask: Which is the biggest city in the world?

faq.a: A megacity is an urban area with more than 10 million people. Examples include Jakarta, Tokyo, Delhi, Cairo, São Paulo, Mexico City and Lagos.
asks: How many people make a megacity?

faq.q: Which is the biggest city in the world?
faq.a: It depends on how you measure. The UN’s 2025 report put Jakarta first, with about 42 million people, then Dhaka and Tokyo. Older lists, which drew city edges differently, put Tokyo first.
asks: Is Tokyo the biggest city in the world?

faq.a: Much of Jakarta sits on soft ground, and for years people pumped water from wells deep below the city, so the ground sank, in places by many centimetres a year. Indonesia is building a new capital, Nusantara, on the island of Borneo.
asks: Why is Indonesia moving its capital?

faq.a: A city can be measured inside its official borders, as a whole built-up urban area or as a wider region. Each way gives a different number, and the UN changed its method in 2025.
asks: Why do lists of the biggest cities differ?

faq.a: Most megacities are in Asia. Others include Cairo, Lagos and Kinshasa in Africa, São Paulo and Mexico City in Latin America, and New York in North America.
asks: Which continent has the most megacities?

facts: A megacity is an urban area with more than 10 million people.
The UN's World Urbanization Prospects 2025 ranked Jakarta, Dhaka and Tokyo as the three largest urban areas.
Indonesia is building a new capital, Nusantara, on the island of Borneo, partly because Jakarta is crowded and sinking.

quiz.say: How many people does a city need to be a megacity?
quiz.why: A megacity is an urban area with more than 10 million people.

wrong.1: A city of 1 million is big, but not a megacity.
wrong.2: 100,000 people is a large town, far from a megacity.

quiz.say: Why can different lists name a different biggest city?
quiz.show: Lists of the biggest cities differ because…

options.show: They draw the city edge in different places
options.say: They draw the city edge in different places

options.show: Cities change their names every year
options.say: Cities change their names every year

quiz.why: Counting only inside official borders, or the whole built-up area, gives very different numbers.

wrong.2: City counts include people of all ages.
